name: fields
lead: Recipes for numbers over the world, for `world.generate`.

functions.name: noise
functions.signature: fields.noise(opts: { seed: number ?, scale: number ?, octaves: number ?, gain: number ?, lacunarity: number ?, solid: boolean ? }?) → Field
functions.description: Smooth noise, about -1..1. `solid = true` changes with y too.

functions.name: mix
functions.signature: fields.mix(a: Field | number, b: Field | number, t: Field | number) → Field

functions.name: hash
functions.description: One number 0..1 for each square of `cell` blocks (1).

functions.name: cells
functions.signature: fields.cells(size: number, seed: number ?) → { distance: Field, random: Field }
functions.description: A scattered grid, one point per `size` blocks: the distance to the nearest point, and that point's own number 0..1.

fields.name: height
fields.description: The y of the surface of a column, as a block.

fields.name: slope
fields.description: The step to the steepest of the four columns beside this one.

fields.name: water
fields.description: How deep the water is over the surface; 0 and below on land.

fields.name: shore
fields.description: 1 on a column at the water's edge with water beside it.

fields.name: room
fields.description: The height of the open space a block is in: 0 in rock, 64 at most (and in the open sky). `density` cannot use it.
